verified_behavior: Each canonical locally parsed job certification produces one informational fit factor through the existing components.fit_factors response used by the generic Job Detail renderer.

Only career facts of kind certification that are sourced, verified, user-approved, and at least 80 confidence support a certification factor; exact local parser identities are compared, and explicitly negative fact statements are excluded.
The factor preserves REQUIRED, PREFERRED, NICE TO HAVE, or UNKNOWN strength in its response and visible label; conflicting repeated strengths resolve to UNKNOWN.
ITIL version and Foundation suffixes remain part of exact certification identity and the visible label; ITIL v3 does not align with v4 or vice versa.
Explicit historical facts, including no-longer-held, formerly-held, previously-held, and used-to-hold wording, do not establish current certification evidence.
A factor always has score_effect NONE and does not change the existing skill evidence score.
When no approved evidence matches, the explanation states that no approved evidence is present and that this does not establish the person lacks the certification.
A rescore after certification-fact approval is revoked replaces the previous result; the new factor and profile version survive Store close and reopen.
limitations: This is a bounded certification explanation slice. The full MJ-REQ-114 and surrounding matching requirements remain PARTIAL.
The generic UI contract was inspected but browser confirmation on the corrected candidate is NOT_RUN because its web build and node_modules are absent; no UI source was changed.
PostgreSQL behavior, hosted CI, hosted review, and broad repository regressions were NOT_RUN. Hosted checks remain NOT_RUN by repository policy.
